title: Meta's Muse is told to keep an hourly page on users' contacts
description:
Meta's Muse keeps an hourly page on every person in a user's life, and Apple says AI agents will need more explicit authorization to reach message histories. Late release due to server issues.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-october-4-2026/

In the headlines (TCR #241):

- Meta's Muse is instructed to keep hourly pages on users' friends and family; Apple tightens macOS full-disk access
- OpenAI's David Robinson quits, calling its culture "broken"; Trillium Labs launches open safety research
- Amazon Web Services pledges $1B+ to data-center communities and says it no longer uses government NDAs for those projects
- Micron says memory supply is "only getting tighter"; Nvidia raises 2019 Shield TV Pro by $100
- arXiv submissions hit 40,363 in September, double 2024, and it announced a general two-paper monthly cap per submitting account
- US, Russia and China curb diesel exports as G7 releases 100 million barrels; US diesel tops $6
